Variants.Content: Cavalry cannot deploy freely in narrow valleys and horses still need water and grass. Albanian war strains coastal exits and household movement; guarded entrances also need exits.

Maskut cavalry cannot deploy freely in narrow valleys. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Albanian war strains coastal exits and household movement.
